title: Mss51 protein inhibition serves as a novel target for type 2 diabetes: a molecular docking and simulation study.
authors: Ali, Shahid; Ahmad, Khurshid; Shaikh, Sibhghatulla; Chun, Hee Jin; Choi, Inho; Lee, Eun Ju
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦Mss51蛋白与小分子抑制剂的分子对接和动力学模拟，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Myostatin is a widely recognized inhibitory factor of skeletal muscle growth and significantly influences muscle development and metabolism. In mice, myostatin inhibition improves insulin sensitivity, increases glucose uptake by skeletal muscle, and reduces body fat. Furthermore, Mss51 is downregulated in response to myostatin inhibition, and its deletion appears to improve the metabolic state of skeletal muscle and reduce adipose tissue, which makes Mss51 a potential target for the treatment of obesity and type 2 diabetes. Here, we report a computationally predicted and validated three-dimensional structure of Mss51. Computational screening was used to identify naturally occurring compounds from the Herbal and Specs chemical database that might inhibit Mss51, based on binding affinities and physiochemical and ADMET properties. ZINC00338371, ZINC95099599 and ZINC08214878 were found to bind to Mss51 with high binding affinity and specificity. In addition, 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations were conducted to assess the stabilities of the interactions between the three compounds and Mss51. MD simulation demonstrated that all three compounds bind to the active pocket site of Mss51 stably and cause conformation changes. ZINC00338371 was found to bind most stably with binding free energy -229.022 +/- 13.776 kJ/mol to Mss51, suggesting that it has therapeutic potential as a treatment option for obesity and type 2 diabetes.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 肌生成抑制素（myostatin）是骨骼肌生长的一种广泛认可的抑制因子，显著影响肌肉发育和代谢。在小鼠中，肌生成抑制素的抑制可提高胰岛素敏感性，增加骨骼肌对葡萄糖的摄取，并减少体脂。此外，Mss51在肌生成抑制素抑制作用下表达下调，其缺失似乎能改善骨骼肌的代谢状态并减少脂肪组织，这使得Mss51成为治疗肥胖和2型糖尿病的潜在靶点。在此，我们报告了通过计算预测并验证的Mss51三维结构。利用计算筛选方法，基于结合亲和力、理化性质及ADMET特性，从Herbal和Specs化学数据库中识别可能抑制Mss51的天然化合物。发现ZINC00338371、ZINC95099599和ZINC08214878能以高结合亲和力和特异性与Mss51结合。此外，进行了100 ns的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，以评估这三种化合物与Mss51之间相互作用的稳定性。MD模拟表明，所有三种化合物均能稳定结合至Mss51的活性口袋位点，并引起构象变化。其中，ZINC00338371与Mss51的结合最为稳定，结合自由能为-229.022 +/- 13.776 kJ/mol，表明其具有作为肥胖和2型糖尿病治疗选择的治疗潜力。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
